decision.reason: [ev-d29ce67c9aa8] is a single changelog line saying an earlier API-server graceful-shutdown fix (#18642/#20981) was reverted in #21221. It doesn't say what the graceful-shutdown behaviour did, whether it was default or depended on configuration, or whether the original fix ever shipped in an earlier release. If the fix never shipped, the revert may cause no net change from the previous release. To write the applicability and consequence, we need the revert PR or the original fix's description, plus the release where #20981 first shipped.
